nodes.title: member.phone.mark_verified: Vyakti staff (actor vp_success, no workspace role) may mark a member's phone verified, with evidence text, audited without the number and with no call placed; same refusals as a code (mobile only, not suppressed or erased, not another member's)
nodes.rationale: On the carrier trial (to 2026-11-16) Plivo rings only sandbox-verified numbers; the owner's phone is verified there, so a staff mark avoids a verification call the trial could refuse.
nodes.reverse_if: the carrier account leaves trial and the in-product code call is proven live; then keep it for support cases only

nodes.title: Carrier truth: shared/carrier.ts maps Plivo hang-up codes (then names, then the Call API refusal text) to a reason, whether the phone rang, the call page code and the retry class. A call that never rang the person does not use their budget; a carrier refusal (trial, caller ID, barring, spam, credit) is OutcomeClass carrier_refused, never retried. The runtime sends call.ended.carrier; the inbound application's hang-up URL is the control plane's signed hook; the CDR is fetched once per call for billed seconds and the INR amount
nodes.rationale: Owner directive 2026-10-24 (calling first): the call log must say what the carrier said, and a trial refusal must not burn the retry ladder.
nodes.reverse_if: the first live trial refusal arrives with a documented hang-up code (then map the code and drop the text match), or Plivo's CDR amounts are not INR on the India account

nodes.title: tests/telephony-verify.test.ts 2/2 and tests/telephony-carrier.test.ts 5/5 on Postgres 16 against fake Plivo servers: in-product verification end to end (one Call API request, signed Speak fetch, confirm); staff mark refused to owner/compliance/system/agent; 15 hang-up mappings; trial refusal not counted and not retried while busy is; CDR once; attach_carrier Application+Number calls; signed hang-up hook; lost call asked to end at 90 s and settled at 10 min
nodes.method: node:test, local fake Plivo HTTP servers, FakeRuntime
